steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: A questionnaire is a set of written questions used to collect data from respondents. | Key Fact: Open questions allow free-text answers (e.g. 'What do you think about…?'); they give detailed responses but are hard to analyse. | Key Fact: Closed questions give a fixed set of response options (e.g. tick boxes, Likert scales); they are easy to analyse but limit answers. | Key Fact: Leading questions influence the respondent to answer in a particular way — they must be avoided.
